query:
SELECT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM kb_machine_clients mc
              WHERE mc.profile_id = $1
                AND ( mc.registered_by_profile_id = $2
                   OR mc.secret_rotated_by_profile_id = $2
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_team_members tm
                               WHERE tm.team_id = mc.team_id AND tm.profile_id = $2
                                 AND tm.role = 'owner'::team_role))) AS "e!: bool"
